name: Galápagos Islands
about: Genuinely a year-round wildlife destination — warm/calm Dec–May vs. cooler nutrient-rich "garua" season Jun–Nov just shift which species shine.
overview: Volcanic islands where wildlife shows zero fear of humans, reachable only by flight and a mandatory park fee.
costOverview: The park entrance and transit card are real one-time costs before anything else — daily food and coffee stay ordinary, but boat-based touring is where the real spending happens.
